HF API Specification - OpenAPI Documentation on HF API v2

xadamxk and TyrantKingBen with the help of Omniscient have published a full fledged HF API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger. You can use your API token to test out API endpoints/queries through the documentation page. Grab the link to the documenation page in the thread and be sure to read the information xadamxk typed up.

Steve Wozniak on Bitcoin
Steve Wozniak co-founded Apple when he was in his mid-20s, in 1976, along with Steve Jobs. The company grew astronomically over time to become one of the most influential and highest-valued companies of all time. There is a vague similarity with Bitcoin when you look at its graph. It has increased in price and popularity over time at unprecedented rates, reaching market capitalizations higher than the GDP of some countries. At the Jalisco Talent Land Digital 2021 event, Wozniak stated how he believed that "Bitcoin is the most amazing mathematical miracle." He went on to say that he "believe[s] in it for the future," like how Apple helped to shape the future. >>Source

The El Salvador Airdrop
It is not often that you hear of an airdrop to an entire country. In fact, this is quite possibly one of the only instances where this has happened with digital currencies.  It is even more surprising when you find out that the cryptocurrency is Bitcoin. Each person in El Salvador is the receive $30 in BTC. Some users on Reddit joked that this would be just enough to cover the transaction fees which, at some point, may be true, although the cost of sending a transaction varies and fluctuates all the time. >>Source

The Banks Fighting Crypto
Congressman Brad Sherman spent a large part of his career working in politics. The Californian Democrat is a known anti-cryptocurrency advocate, claiming to highlight threats that digital currencies pose to the U.S. financial system. The same financial system that he is, in fact, taking his donations from. It was revealed that some of his largest donors are banks and financial institutions. It makes you wonder just how many people who oppose cryptocurrencies receive donations from these companies. >>Source


Pokémon TV Anime Brings Back Dawn, Her Piplup After 9 Years for Summer Special Episodes
The character from the Pokémon series Dawn is one of the most iconic characters. Dawn and her main Pokémon, Piplup, were one of the most loved companions Ash had. Finally, after nine years not showing on screen, both Dawn and Piplup are making a comeback for the summer's special episodes that will air on July 23 and July 30.

The episodes will follow Ash and Goh's return to the Sinnoh region in order to investigate strange occurrences that have been plaguing its citizens, such as nightmares that have been linked to Darkrai. After meeting Chloe while she was on her own journey, Dawn joins the crew in their journey to uncover the truth behind everyone's nightmares.>>Source

Ani-One Asia Streams RE-MAIN Water Polo Anime
RE-MAIN anime's story focuses on a boy named Minato and his water polo team. Minato used to play water polo but he stopped after some incident in his third middle school year. Later on Minato started high school and started playing again with a new team. As the anime goes on, Minato and his team run into many problems.

On Thursday it was announced by MediaLink Entertainment Limited Ani-One Asia that they will start streaming the anime RE-MAIN. The anime will premiere on July 4 and will be available for Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brunei, Cambodia, Fiji, Guam, India, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Macau, Malaysia, Maldives, Marshall Islands, Mauritius, Micronesia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nauru, Nepal, New Caledonia, Northern Mariana Island, Pakistan, Palau, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Samoa, Seychelles, Singapore, Solomon Islands, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Vanuatu, and Vietnam. >>Source
